text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp was over in the blink 
of an eye. As for Bamboo Memory, who had 
been crying tears of joy when it began—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
—Gasp!!! I was just so dazed because I 
couldn't accept the reality that summer 
training camp is over, sir!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
However! We can't keep clinging to 
lingering thoughts of summer camp 
forever!! Am I right, Trainer!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"The Sprinters Stakes is almost here! 
Ooooh! I'm fired up, I'm so fired up!!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Is it cool if I run all the way 
back to the academy?!
choice_data_list:
Let's uphold public morals and take the 
bus back!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Yes, sir!! I'm taking the bus back!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Sprinters Stakes was right around the 
corner! Eager to show the results of the 
summer camp there, she held back her 
rushing excitement on the bus ride home!
